verdict.rationale: Medusa's docs reference a generic Payment Module (medusa-docs-24) that is designed for integrating third-party payment providers, not a first-party processor with its own published card rates, payouts, or fraud tooling — no evidence of any native Medusa-branded payment processing service. The evidence pack contains no published card rates, payout schedules, or fraud-detection tooling under Medusa's own brand.
